flow.homeTitle: From prompt to certified code — my pipeline on a board.
flow.homeLead: I build with AI in a human way: I use skills to spin up sub-agents that debate each idea, weigh trade-offs, and only then we move on — with review, tests, security, and real validation. Click a node to see the step.
flow.headline: How I build — from prompt to certified code.
flow.lead: It’s not “ask and paste”: I orchestrate AI with skills and sub-agents that debate the best solution, and I only move forward after proof (tests, security, and ops).
flow.canvasHint: Click a node · dashed lines = loop back
flow.principle1Body: Before generating code, I explain the problem in human language and build the brief — the prompt becomes the contract for the agent team, not a guess.
flow.principle2Body: Sub-agents and I review together; then come tests and security. If it fails, the flow loops back — it does not go to production.
flow.principle3Body: Ops and parallel deploy (Docker + Coolify) close the cycle: prove in production without taking down the main system.

prompt.title: Brief / Prompt
prompt.body: I sit with the real problem: what hurts in operations, what already exists, what “done” means. That becomes a clear brief for the AI — no ambiguity.
prompt.how: I write the ask like I’m explaining it to a teammate: context, limits, examples, and acceptance. That brief feeds the skills that orchestrate the next steps.
prompt.check: Without a human, clear brief, I don’t start generation. The prompt is the agreement of the flow.

vibe.title: Vibe coding
vibe.body: Here the AI writes with me in fast cycles — but never alone. I use skills to create sub-agents that debate each idea (approach A vs B, trade-offs), and we only implement what makes the most sense.
vibe.how: I ask for focused chunks, let the sub-agents “talk through” the best solution, and I pick the path. Speed with judgment — not blind accept-all.
vibe.check: Output: a working draft aligned with the debate. Review, tests, and security still ahead.

review.title: Human review
review.body: I step back in as a human: I read architecture, edge cases, and whether it really helps day-to-day work — not just “it compiles.”
review.how: I challenge what the agents produced: what breaks? what’s leftover? what wasn’t asked? I adjust by hand before formalizing tests.
review.check: The final call is mine. AI and sub-agents suggest; I own the design.

tests.title: Tests
tests.body: I prove behavior on the flows that matter — unit, integration, regression — so the theoretical debate becomes evidence.
tests.how: I cover happy and failure paths. If it breaks, I return to vibe/review with the agents: no evidence, no progress.
tests.check: Dashed line on the map: mandatory loop when tests don’t pass.

security.title: Security
security.body: I treat the code as if it came from outside: auth, input, secrets, permissions, and attack surface — especially what the AI invented.
security.how: I do an explicit security review (sometimes with a risk-focused sub-agent) before any deploy.
security.check: Risk found = loop back. Security is not optional.

ops.title: Ops & validation
ops.body: I put the system in a real scenario: logs, integrations, expected failures, and day-to-day operator use.
ops.how: I simulate the routine — not only the notebook happy path. If operations break, the flow returns and we debate again.
ops.check: Only what behaves under real use moves forward.

deploy.title: Test in production
deploy.body: I ship in parallel to the main system: Docker isolates the new version and Coolify brings it up without taking down what’s live — so we test for real, with real people, without drama.
deploy.how: I spin up the parallel environment, run controlled smoke tests, then promote. If something fails, main stays intact.
deploy.check: Main production stays stable. The final proof is parallel deploy — not “final code” that never goes live.
